title: SMaRT: Select, Mix, and ReinvenT — A Strategy Fusion Framework for LLM-Driven Reasoning and Planning
reasoning: The paper presents a strategy fusion framework (SMaRT) for enhancing LLM reasoning and planning capabilities. It evaluates the system on technical and logistical benchmarks like GSM8K, ALFWorld, and TravelPlanner, without any focus on religious, moral, or ethical traditions or evaluations.
